description:
Explore the Museum of Croydon and Croydon Archives:

- Join the Curator of the Museum of Croydon and the Borough Archivist of the Croydon Archives on an intimate guided tour of our stored, rarely seen collections.
- Explore our current exhibitions with our expert staff, including Grayson Perry's Essex House Tapestries and a brand-new exhibition on Croydon's Architecture

factsheet.heading: Visit our object store facilities
paragraphs: This is a rare opportunity to see behind-the-scenes of a local history museum with a fascinating collection including archaeological, domestic and fine art objects.

factsheet.heading: Explore archival material
paragraphs: Explore the Croydon Archives stores with the Borough Archivist, containing over 1200 collections (138k+ items) of archival material.

factsheet.heading: Explore our exhibition on Croydon's Architecture
paragraphs: Explore the history of Croydon's Architecture in a brand-new exhibition in our Special Exhibition Galleries, Level 1.

factsheet.heading: Discover Grayson Perry's 'Essex House Tapestries'
paragraphs: Explore this temporary exhibition showcasing The Essex House Tapestries: The Life of Julie Cope by Sir Grayson Perry in our Special Exhibitions Gallery, Level 1.

travel_info: Additional travel info: Our meeting point will be outside the Special Exhibition Galleries on Level 1 of the Croydon Clocktower.
